title: Exponential bounds for a perturbation |u| <= (Lambda/4) q (parent step 11 (a)-(d))
statement: Let Lambda, q, u be real numbers with Lambda > 0, 0 <= q <= 1 and |u| <= (Lambda/4) q. Then e^(-Lambda) <= e^u, e^u <= e^Lambda, |e^u - 1| <= (e^(Lambda/2)/2) Lambda q, and, if Lambda <= 1, |e^u - 1| <= Lambda q.
lean_statement: ∀ (Λ q u : ℝ), 0 < Λ → 0 ≤ q → q ≤ 1 → |u| ≤ Λ / 4 * q → Real.exp (-Λ) ≤ Real.exp u ∧ Real.exp u ≤ Real.exp Λ ∧ |Real.exp u - 1| ≤ Real.exp (Λ / 2) / 2 * Λ * q ∧ (Λ ≤ 1 → |Real.exp u - 1| ≤ Λ * q)
